mechanism: Tranylcypromine is a nonselective MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate hypertensive effects; pyrazinamide has been associated with hyperuricemia and metabolic complications that may compound hypertensive risk in MAOI-treated patients.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with close blood pressure monitoring and dose adjustment; consider alternative antitubercular regimen if MAOI therapy is essential.
